card.name: Just before arthritis indication and dose terms
card.fires_on: Small words and word starts in rheumatology labels, mainly "Non" before "-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis". Also the space before a week number or dose, and "the" before "treatment of RA".

modes.label: Non-radiographic
modes.description: The word "Non" starting the phrase non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis.
modes.example: 2.4 Recommended Dosage for<< Non>>-Radiographic Axial Spondy

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: The space or unit just before a week number or dose value in a dosing schedule.

modes.label: Linking word
modes.description: A short word or brand-name piece in an immunology drug label, before a disease or drug name.
modes.example: Avoid use of B<<IM>>ZELX in patients with active I

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly promotes 'mass' variants and suppresses 'disease' words.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a disease name or dose number in arthritis drug labels.
